perspective:
**Ethan Mohamud’s available information:**

- Ethan is a plumber and has been close friends with Gary Guo since middle school.
- Ethan noticed Gary working excessively long hours at the hospital, often skipping meals and sacrificing sleep. This concerned Ethan.
- Ethan invited Gary to a weekend retreat for relaxation and rejuvenation.
- Ethan told Gary that his health matters and that he hated seeing him like this, suggesting two days away might give him a new perspective.
- Ethan heard Gary decline, saying he appreciated the concern but could not go because there was too much to do at the hospital.
- At the retreat, Ethan observed Gary acting restless and avoiding discussions about work.
- Ethan suspected there was more to Gary’s overworking than professional obligations.
- Ethan confronted Gary, reminding him they had been friends since middle school and that Gary could tell him anything; Ethan said he was there to help, not judge.
- Ethan heard Gary respond that it was complicated and that he did not want to burden Ethan with his problems.
- After that confrontation, Gary opened up to Ethan about the pressures of managing a new department and personal challenges he was facing.
- Ethan felt relief and empathy after understanding more of Gary’s situation.
- Ethan suggested prioritizing tasks and delegating responsibilities so Gary would not have to do everything himself.
- Ethan heard Gary agree, saying he could use help organizing his schedule to make time for himself.
- Over the following months, Ethan regularly checked in with Gary about his progress and remaining challenges.
- Ethan heard Gary say things were better, that Ethan’s help meant he was less overwhelmed, and that he had time for a movie the previous weekend.
- Ethan felt hopeful and proud of Gary’s progress and continued offering support and encouragement.
- After a year, Ethan saw Gary as capable of managing on his own and believed Gary had adjusted to a healthier work-life balance.
- Ethan felt satisfied and happy for Gary, decided to step back, and told Gary he was always just a call away if needed.
- Ethan heard Gary thank him, say he could not have done it without Ethan’s support, and that he felt more in control now.
